name: Leda Dunn Wettre
service_line_reviewed: Service reviewed: Serving since April 2, 2015 through September 13, 2026. Selected decisions: 3.

biography.text: Wettre earned a B.A., cum laude, from the University of Pennsylvania (1990) and a J.D. from Fordham University School of Law (1993), where she was a managing editor of the law review. She clerked for U.S. District Judge John F. Keenan, practiced at Kramer Levin, and became a partner at Robinson Wettre & Miller, handling complex commercial, IP, shareholder, class, and employment litigation. She has chaired the court’s Local Rules Committee.
